name: Original Payment Instruction 53
definition: Provides detailed information on the original transaction, to which the status report message refers.

ReversalPaymentInformationIdentification.name: Reversal Payment Information Identification
ReversalPaymentInformationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party, to unambiguously identify the reversed payment information group.|Usage: The instructing party is the party sending the reversal message and not the party that sent the original instruction that is being reversed.

OriginalPaymentInformationIdentification.name: Original Payment Information Identification
OriginalPaymentInformationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original sending party, to unambiguously identify the original payment information group.

OriginalNumberOfTransactions.name: Original Number Of Transactions
OriginalNumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the original payment information group.

OriginalControlSum.name: Original Control Sum
OriginalControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the original payment information group, irrespective of currencies.

BatchBooking.name: Batch Booking
BatchBooking.definition: Identifies whether a single entry per individual transaction or a batch entry for the sum of the amounts of all transactions within the group of a message is requested.|Usage: Batch booking is used to request and not order a possible batch booking.

PaymentInformationReversal.name: Payment Information Reversal
PaymentInformationReversal.definition: Indicates whether or not the reversal applies to the complete original payment information group or to individual transactions within that group.

ReversalReasonInformation.name: Reversal Reason Information
ReversalReasonInformation.definition: Provides detailed information on the reversal reason.

TransactionInformation.name: Transaction Information
TransactionInformation.definition: Provides information on the original transactions to which the reversal message refers.

PaymentInformationReversalAndTransaction.definition: If PaymentInformationReversal is true, then TransactionInformation is not allowed.
If PaymentInformationReversal is false, then at least one occurrence of TransactionInformation must be present.

PaymentInformationReversalAndReasonRule.definition: If PaymentInformationReversal is true, then ReversalReasonInformation/ReversalReason must present.
